subject: Vendor record update: bank account change and HQ address move
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@summitindustries.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@summitindustries.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: update vendor banking and HQ address

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — following our onboarding last quarter, Summit Industries needs to update our vendor record with a new bank account and corporate HQ address. We changed banks for improved international railings and moved our head office to a new building in Denver.

What we are asking Redwood to update: 
- Primary payee bank account (new account details attached on the Bank Change Form)
- Billing / remit address (new HQ address for POs and invoices)
- Replace tax form on file (attached updated W-9)

We’ve attached the filled Bank Change Form and a scanned voided check, plus the updated W-9. Can you confirm the documents your AP team needs and an estimated cutover date for payments? Ideally we'd like the new account to be active for invoices dated 09/01/2027.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Finance — Summit Industries
elena.ruiz@summitindustries.com
+1 (303) 555-4882

Attachments: SummitCo_BankChange_Form.pdf, SummitCo_W9.pdf, SummitCo_VoidedCheck.jpg
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@summitindustries.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: update vendor banking and HQ address

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sending the forms. The attachments came through and look complete at first glance. A few notes on process and next steps: 

- Required items for AP to process a bank change: completed vendor bank change form (signed), copy of voided check or bank letter, updated W-9. You provided all three — thank you.

- Cutover timing: our standard processing window is 7–10 business days after AP verifies the documents and the vendor portal record is updated. Because you requested a 09/01 effective date, we should begin the change request this week to meet that timeline. If AP needs additional verification, that will push the date.

- PO implications: existing POs issued before the change remain billable to the old account until AP confirms the switch in the ledger. Please mark any invoices with the new remit address once the change is confirmed to avoid routing delays.

I’ve looped in Karthik from Finance to issue the verification checklist and run the vendor update in the AP system. Lauren — could you open a vendor-change ticket and send the secure upload link to Summit (we prefer the vendor portal URL or DocuSign for bank letters)?

Elena — I’ll confirm back with the ticket number and expected processing timeline within one business day.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Jonas / Lauren — I reviewed the submitted materials. Docs look valid; W-9 matches EIN and company name. I opened vendor-change ticket RWF-2027-1129 and started the AP verification. Actions taken: 

- Uploaded documents to the secure vendor portal (link: https://redwood.app/portal/vendors/record/789234)
- Notified AP to flag any invoices dated 2027-08-31 or earlier to pay to legacy account; invoices dated 2027-09-01 onward to be routed to new account after verification.
- Reached out to bank verification team; they may call Marco Diaz if micro-deposit verification is required.

Estimate: 5–8 business days for full verification barring bank callback. Will update ticket and notify Elena when final switch is scheduled.

Thanks,
